nature.name: Nature
welcomePhrases: Welcome explorer! Nature is full of surprising life.
Let us discover amazing ecosystems together.
Get ready to meet incredible living things.

space.name: Space
welcomePhrases: Welcome astronaut! Space is huge and exciting.
Let us travel through planets and stars.
Ready for a cosmic learning journey?

history.name: History
welcomePhrases: History helps us understand people from the past.
Let us meet civilizations and inventors.

technology.name: Technology
welcomePhrases: Welcome builder! Technology solves real problems.
Let us explore inventions from robots to clean energy.

human-body.name: Human Body
welcomePhrases: Welcome scientist! Your body is a living wonder.
Let us explore bones, senses, and the brain.
Ready to learn how your body works?

arts.name: Arts
welcomePhrases: Welcome creator! Art tells stories without limits.
Let us discover sounds, colors, and shapes.

arctic-fox.title: Arctic Fox
arctic-fox.summary: The arctic fox has thick fur and small ears that help it keep heat in icy weather.
questions: How does it stay warm in winter?
Why does its coat color change?
What does it eat in the tundra?

coral-reef.title: Coral Reef
coral-reef.summary: A coral reef is a busy underwater city where fish and tiny animals live together.

redwood.title: Redwood Tree
redwood.summary: Redwood trees are some of the tallest trees on Earth and can live for centuries.
questions: How tall can a redwood grow?

saturn.title: Saturn
saturn.summary: Saturn is a giant planet famous for bright rings made of ice and rock.
questions: What are Saturn's rings made of?

apollo-11.title: Apollo 11
apollo-11.summary: Apollo 11 was the first mission that landed humans on the Moon in 1969.
questions: Who walked on the Moon first?

sun.title: The Sun
sun.summary: The Sun is a star that gives Earth light and heat, making life possible.
questions: Why does the Sun look yellow?

egypt.title: Ancient Egypt
egypt.summary: Ancient Egypt grew near the Nile River and built pyramids, temples, and writing systems.

printing-press.title: Printing Press
printing-press.summary: The printing press helped books spread quickly and made learning available to many people.

magellan.title: Magellan Expedition
magellan.summary: Magellan's expedition completed the first trip around the world, proving Earth can be circled by sea.
questions: How long did the expedition last?

mars-rover.title: Mars Rover
mars-rover.summary: A Mars rover is a robot explorer that studies rocks and weather on Mars.
questions: How does a rover move on Mars?
What data does it send home?

solar-panels.title: Solar Panels
solar-panels.summary: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity that can power homes and schools.
questions: Can they work on cloudy days?

high-speed-train.title: High-Speed Train
high-speed-train.summary: High-speed trains use powerful electric systems and smooth tracks to travel very fast.

femur.title: Femur
femur.summary: The femur is the strongest bone in your body and helps you stand, walk, and jump.
questions: How does it connect to the hip?
How can we keep bones healthy?

neurons.title: Neurons
neurons.summary: Neurons are tiny cells that carry messages through your brain and body.
questions: Why are sleep and neurons connected?

eyes.title: Eyes
eyes.summary: Your eyes collect light and send signals to the brain so you can see the world.
questions: How can we protect our eyes?

violin.title: Violin
violin.summary: The violin creates sound when strings vibrate and the wooden body amplifies the tone.
questions: How many strings does a violin have?

watercolor.title: Watercolor
watercolor.summary: Watercolor painting uses water and pigment to create soft, transparent layers.

marble.title: Marble Sculpture
marble.summary: Marble sculpture is made by carving stone carefully to reveal shapes and details.
questions: How long can a sculpture last?
